The fix:
```c
end = line + strlen(line);
start_from = line + (cptr - buf) + strlen(cptr) + 1;
if (start_from > end)

line = skip_white(start_from);
```

This clamps `start_from` to `end`. So `skip_white` reads at most at `end` (the null terminator). That prevents the overflow for the case where the token extends to the end.
